messages:
Priya: Quick proposal: a tiny helper command for deploy-bot that emits a short 'release brief' + a suggested pins.yaml and a rollback snippet. Should be output-only by default.

Priya: CLI sketch:
```
deploy-bot brief-clip --version v2.0.1 --canary 5 --changelog CHANGES.md --dry-run
```
It should produce: 1) one-line release summary, 3 bullet highlights, 2) suggested pins.yaml content, 3) rollback.sh snippet, 4) optional perf snapshot.

Noah: def output-only. We get too many accidental apply events otherwise. Make `--apply --confirm` required to actually change anything.

Marta: add preflight: block if there are active rollouts. Deploy-Bot: preflight: 0 active rollouts on project/redwood-core — brief-clip dry-run allowed. :white_check_mark:

Priya: heuristics for risk label: if image OR model changed -> at least medium; infra-only -> low; >5 critical path files -> high. Include that as "Risk: <low|medium|high>" in the brief.

Noah: include `--include-pr-links` opt-in and `--email-draft` to output a short paragraph for release email. Keep privacy default off.

Deploy-Bot: note: brief-clip will append metadata to suggested pins.yaml: generated_by, timestamp, source_commit.

Priya: example dry-run output:
--- brief.md ---
v2.0.1 (canary 5%) — Small perf and reliability improvements.
Highlights:
- fix: KV cache race under burst load (PR #1203)
- perf: improved batching for short sequences (PR #1198)
- ops: add model-variant fallback (PR #1210)
Risk: medium (image + runtime)

--- pins.yaml ---
service: redwood-api:sha256:8f7a1b2c
model: reasoner-v3:2025-02-11
# generated_by: deploy-bot brief-clip
# timestamp: 2025-02-11T14:02:41Z
# source_commit: abcd1234

--- rollback.sh ---
#!/bin/bash
# rollback to previous pins
deployctl apply --pin-file pins.prev.yaml --rollout 100

--- perf-snapshot (optional) ---
qps: 120  p99: 220ms

Marta: nice. Also include a small checklist block for oncall: canary health checks, log spikes, error budget, who to page.

Noah: make output machine-friendly by separating sections with `---` so CI can consume them. Also a `--format json` for automation might be handy later.

Priya: implementation plan: I'll make a small Go CLI that reads CHANGES.md, fetches top PR titles, and formats the brief. Marta will add preflight hooks and Noah will wire perf snapshot. We'll demo in the release kickoff.

Marta: one more: add `--skip-preflight` but only allowed with `--confirm` and must emit a conspicuous warning in the output.

Deploy-Bot: reminder: any `--apply` actions require an audit entry and will tag release owner.

Leo: ping me for wording before PR merge; I'll help craft the email draft and blurb for the console.

Priya: thanks team — opening PR today.
